text:
maria: Hi team — quick heads up: our adoption finalized today! Were picking up the kids next month but theres a visa/intercountry packet to submit. What's the process for leave and any reimbursement for legal/visa fees? Also need to arrange a temporary contractor to cover my core responsibilities for 12 weeks.

emily: Huge congrats, Maria!! :tada: For adoption-related leave, please open the leave request at https://redwood.hr/leave and choose "Adoption/Placement". Upload the placement letter or final decree once you have it. Redwood offers 8 weeks paid primary caregiver leave plus an adoption assistance reimbursement up to $5,000 for eligible expenses. We'll need receipts/invoice for visa/legal fees.

maria: Thanks. The agency sent an invoice now — can I submit it before the official placement? The travel and embassy fees will be billed before the pickup date.

emily: Yes — for adoption assistance we can pre-approve estimated costs. Submit a reimbursement request at https://redwood.hr/expenses with subject `Adoption assistance - preapproval` and attach the invoice. We'll mark it as pre-approved pending final placement docs. Keep the receipts and the embassy fee receipts.

sam: Congrats, Maria! For the contractor backfill, what's the hiring timeline? We can spin up a 12-week contractor if People Ops approves funding. @hiringops do we have budget band for short-term backfills?

hiringops: We have a short-term backfill pool. Please submit a Backfill Request form: https://redwood.hr/hiring/backfill with `duration=12_weeks` and list required skills. Once approved, Talent will try to source within 7 business days. Tag `priority:adoption-backfill` for faster routing.

maria: I'll file that now. Also need to ship a laptop to the country of placement for a short period while I'm traveling. Is that allowed?

emily: Shipping company equipment internationally has extra compliance steps. File a hardware transfer ticket with Facilities: https://redwood.tools/facilities and choose `international-shipment`. Facilities will coordinate export paperwork and insurance; include travel dates and return ETA. If the laptop stays outside the US >90 days, we may need additional approvals.

facilities-bot: Automated: New ticket created #FAC-7192 (international-shipment). Please attach passport/itinerary redactions if required. Facilities will confirm pickup window within 2 business days.

maria: Noted. What about health insurance coverage start for the kids? Do they count as dependents immediately upon placement?

emily: Dependents can be added within 31 days of placement. Submit the dependent enrollment form at https://redwood.hr/benefits/enroll and attach the placement paperwork. If you miss the 31-day window, we'll need a special enrollment exception.

maria: And 401k/leave pay interactions? Since I'll be on paid leave, contributions continue, right?

emily: If you're on Redwood-paid leave (STD/top-up), payroll will continue to process salary-based benefits, so 401k deferrals remain as elected. If you switch to unpaid leave after the paid period, employee deferrals pause. Payroll-bot will post exact schedule once claims are approved.

payroll-bot: Automated: For Adoption Leave claims, submit form ID `ADP-2026` via https://redwood.hr/claims. Reimbursements processed within one payroll cycle after claim approval. Employer adoption assistance is taxable; confirm W-2 impact with payroll.

maria: About visa paperwork: will Redwood reimburse translation/legalization fees and courier costs?

emily: Yes — translation, legalization/notarization, embassy fees, and reasonable courier charges are eligible. Itemize them in the reimbursement form and attach supporting docs. If you need an upfront payment beyond $5k cap, People Ops can escalate for special approval.

sam: Quick ops note: Maria, can you list the 3 most critical weekly tasks for the contractor? We'll include them in the backfill request.
maria: Sure: 1) oncall rotation coordination and urgent customer handoffs; 2) weekly infra deploy review and rollback readiness; 3) code review for shipping model config changes. I'll paste a short SOP into the backfill form.

hiringops: Received backfill request `BF-8810`. Talent will ping the hiring manager for a 30-min intake. Please be available for a quick call today if possible.

maria: I can do a 30-min intake at 4pm. Also, any tax paperwork I should expect for the adoption assistance reimbursement?

emily: Adoption assistance reimbursements over the IRS exclusion may be taxable. Payroll will provide the taxable amount, and you'll see it on your next paystub and W-2. We recommend checking with your tax advisor for specifics.

maria: Thank you all. Filing leave, expense preapproval, and backfill now. Appreciate the quick help.

emily: Sending the preapproval checklist DM and tagging payroll/hiring to prioritize. Big congrats again, Maria!! :gift_heart:
